originality.rationale: Uchiumi 2026, Proposition 4.1, explicitly supplies the factorized generating function for all reciprocal-integer-axis cross-polytopes; that input is credited and not proposed as new. The distinct theorem classifies exactly which weights yield complete period collapse, determines the least quasiperiod for every integer weight vector, and proves a sharp least-dimension and unique-extremizer theorem for each dyadic denominator, with a sparse Ehrhart numerator and a lattice-realizability obstruction. Clarke-Higashitani-Koelbl 2022 already cover weights 1 repeated and 2 once, and the two-dimensional example is not new. The structural all-weight optimization is not stated in inspected primary sections. Closely implied by the known generating function, so independent priority review remains important.
residual_risks: The arbitrary-weight generating function is already known, and pole cancellation is an elementary route to the classification; prior unindexed implicit treatments could subsume some or all refinements.
Woods and McAllister-Woods full texts were not examined in this round; their general and planar scope is acknowledged.
Search results are not a uniqueness certificate, and independent priority validation remains outstanding.
